objects.description: During the [2015 Ukraine Electric Power Attack](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0028), power breakers were opened which caused the operating companies to be unable to deliver power, and left thousands of businesses and households without power for around 6 hours. (Citation: Ukraine15 - EISAC - 201603)(Citation: Booz Allen Hamilton)
